notes.title: Progression Systems are Progressing!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Adventurers! [/p][p][/p][p]Gold jingles in your purse and glory swells in your heart, but the [b]greatest reward[/b] is the strength you carry forward. Today, we’re pulling back the curtain on some of the [b]systems that let your heroes grow mightier[/b] as they conquer the depths of the Vault. [/p][p][/p][p]These are [b]early design drafts[/b], so expect a few tweaks along the road! [/p][p][/p][h3]Hero Level [/h3][p]We’re excited to unveil the next stage of your journey into the Abomination Vaults! As you venture deeper, your party will grow [b]stronger [/b]with each challenge you overcome. This, of course, is represented by levelling up! [/p][p][/p][p]We plan to utilize a [b]"milestone" progression system[/b], in which the heroes level-up upon defeating each floor's final major encounter or boss battle. Upon level-up, each hero immediately receives a handful of benefits:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Stat Increases:[/b] Each hero receives an HP increase reflecting their class’s natural hardiness, as well as Power and Defense: attributes that affect the heroes’ ability to output damage and healing and resist incoming damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Abilities: [/b]For example, at Level 2, Ezren can gain access to [i]Wall of Fire[/i]! You can freely equip new abilities via the Loadout Menu before or during any adventure. [/p][/*][*][p][b]One Feat Point:[/b] Feats are powerful passive bonuses spent in the Feat Tree, which is accessed at the Otari Garrison.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Each level-up further expands your capacity to customize each member of the squad. The role your characters play, whether [b]offensive, defensive, supportive, or a hybrid,[/b] is yours to shape![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/cb102bb5764e902e38d3f48700e529da63193d9e.png"][/img][i]A Hero Level-Up screen displaying unlocks for each character[/i] [/p][p][/p][h3]The Feat Tree[/h3][p]To further reflect the growth of each character during the adventure, the team has begun work on the [b]Feat system[/b]. Players will access the [b]Feat Tree[/b] by speaking with Captain Longsaddle at the Otari Garrison. Here you’ll spend [b]Feat Points[/b] to hone your heroes’ specialties. If you ever wish to walk a different path, you may [b]re-spec your Feat Points[/b] for a fresh start.[/p][p]
Each hero’s Feat Tree currently branches into [b]three specializations [/b]containing four feats related to specific ideas like [b]Amiri’s ‘Rage’[/b] state, [b]Kyra’s tanking[/b] capabilities, or [b]Harsk’s ranged attacks.[/b] Choosing all four feats in a cluster will unlock its inner “[b]Mastery” Feat[/b], a potent additional power granted as a reward for your specialization. Will you cherry-pick the best feats from each cluster, or focus your points into one path for the valuable Mastery Feats? [b]Let us know what you think[/b] of this system![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/0581e4827f1d655835b9b7fb081fafdf075ee967.png"][/img][i]The Feat Tree displaying specialisations and unlocks for each Hero[/i] [/p][p][/p][h3]Party Bond [/h3][p]Another concept we’ve been looking at is called the [b]Party Bond[/b], which represents the trust forged in battle between your party members. This design [b]rewards teamwork and squad play[/b], bringing everyone together! 

In this system, actions such as performing [b]combo attacks[/b], pulling off [b]team plays[/b], and watching each other’s backs earn [b]Party Bond XP[/b]. As your bond strengthens, the entire party reaps the benefits, climbing from [b]Tier 1 to Tier 10[/b] over the course of the adventure.
 
Each Tier earned grants ever-greater blessings, such as [b]increased combo effect damage and healing, faster ally revival, [/b]and [b]longer-lasting support effects[/b]. Work together and reap the rewards![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/39ba2587655311585016c7e47847ca4d5ad2a06a.png"][/img][i]The Party Bond Icon at the Centre of the Feat Tree[/i] 
 
We hope this first glimpse into our progression systems has been insightful. We can’t wait to hear how you build your heroes, master your Feat Trees, and strengthen your Party Bonds.
 
[b]Join us in the [url="https://discord.gg/cW46qDgT2K"]official Discord[/url][/b] for deeper lore, design insights, and tavern chatter as the game continues to take shape! We’re eager to hear your thoughts![/p][p][/p][h3]Starfinder: Afterlight – Support the Kickstarter! [/h3][p]Our friends at [url="https://www.epictellers.com/"]Epictellers Entertainment[/url] are creating a [b]party-based RPG[/b] that brings Paizo’s beloved [b]science-fantasy universe[/b] to life! It’s time to gather your crew and save the galaxy in a game featuring the [b]Starfinder 2e ruleset[/b] where magic meets technology.  
 
You can support the project by checking out their [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/epictellers/starfinder-afterlight?ref=e45g4g&utm_source=bkom&utm_campaign=ks&utm_medium=web&utm_content=chareveal"]Kickstarter page[/url] and [b]wishlisting the game for free[/b] on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3245640/Starfinder_Afterlight/?utm_source=bkom&utm_campaign=ks&utm_medium=website&utm_content=chareveal"]Steam[/url]!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/130b14762884cc178426d230ec48d155e519ee1b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Experience turn-based tactical combat with Starfinder’s classes: Soldier, Envoy, Operative,                       Mystic, Solarian and Witchwarper[/i][/p][p][/p][p]In Starfinder: Afterlight’s branching narrative, [b]your choices [i]matter[/i][/b]. notes.title: Tabletop to Hack and Slash: The Caligni
notes.content:
[p align="justify"]Hail, fellow Pathfinders! [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]One of our favourite parts of developing the game is translating Pathfinder 2E’s rich lore and crunchy mechanics from “Tabletop format” to “Action RPG viable”. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]We want to take you along this journey to show just how we’re staying true to the beloved source material. Today, we’re starting with the strange and mysterious inhabitants of the Darklands: [b]the Caligni.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"][i][b]- Wyatt, Creative Director at BKOM[/b][/i] [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2]Immersion and Understanding [/h2][p align="justify"]We began by digging into the Caligni's tragic history. Once people of the mighty Azlanti empire who reigned over Golarion, they fled underground millennia ago to survive the cataclysmic Earthfall. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]In desperation, they made a pact with malevolent demigods known as the Forsaken, who transformed them into resilient and merciless subterranean dwellers capable of surviving the Darklands. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]As part of the deal, when a Caligni dies, they combust in a burst of light and flame, with their soul energy feeding the Forsaken… a cruel irony, as the Forsaken vanished long ago and no longer watch over them, meaning their souls feed no-one! [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Caligni combatants are split into distinct societal and battlefield roles, such as Stalkers, Callers, and Vanguards, and many other roles. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]The last piece of the Caligni puzzle is the Owbs, strange ancient beings from the Shadow Plane who the Caligni have come to worship and obey. These powerful creatures guide and manipulate the Caligni to their bidding. Whether the Owbs are manifestations of the ancient Forsaken, or simply imposters, is shrouded in mystery. [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/bdd3bf553d1cf08bc3d49752741db8c4cfb1f804.png"][/img][/p][h2]Building out Battlefield Roles [/h2][p align="justify"]Once we had a handle on who they were, we started dreaming up how different Caligni types would play out on the battlefield. We didn’t want Caligni to fight like normal foes - we wanted a cohesive but unusual fighting force that will challenge players in new ways. [/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Caligni Skulkers:[/b] We envision Skulkers as meat-and-potatoes minions of the Caligni. They fight like rogues, zipping in and out of combat and whittling away at the heroes. The heroes will need agility, precision, and teamwork to corner the Skulkers and take them out efficiently.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Caligni Vanguard:[/b] We designed the Vanguard to be slow, powerful juggernauts who shake the battlefield with their heavy great sword strikes. Their presence forces heroes to manoeuvre around the battlefield to avoid devastating blows.  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Caligni Callers:[/b] These are the “support types” of the Caligni forces: deadly glass-cannon priests who cripple the heroes with dark magics borrowed from their Owb masters, while empowering their Caligni allies to greater heights of ferocity. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Owbs:[/b] We envision Owbs as powerful elite ranged enemies who use their shadowy “Curse of Darkness” to obliterate heroes from afar. Owbs will reposition when approached, hiding behind Caligni servants. When an Owb is on the battlefield, the heroes must pay attention to its attacks, or be wiped out by its shadow magic instantly. [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p align="justify"]These designs are certain to evolve as we move forward with implementation and testing, so we look forward to letting you see the final implementation once we’ve tested everything out on the battlefield! [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2]An Explosive Finale [/h2][p align="justify"]One of the most defining aspects of the Caligni is how they die. Thanks to a nasty pact made ages ago, when a Caligni falls, they explode in a burst of flame and light. This was fun to translate over into gameplay: When a Caligni is defeated, a small AoE preview is displayed which heroes must escape (usually with a dodge) to avoid suffering a burst of damage and crowd control. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]But after playtesting, we soon realized that we had totally overdone it with our death blasts! They were constantly stunning, killing, debuffing, and displacing the heroes: there were too many Caligni and, in the cramped corridors of the Darklands, not enough space to escape easily. It felt that we ended up spending more time avoiding death blasts than fighting the Caligni!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/344dc072da8ad0b8219a40a9e2bcf3a7a05c673c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]However, this element of the Caligni is too important to their identity to simply abandon! Instead, we carefully dialled down the severity of the various death blasts until they provided the right balance of punishment and player agency. Now, taking out a Caligni still means being ready to roll out, but hopefully won’t lead to being pinballed around into five different explosions while your HP bar empties out.  [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Ultimately, we want the “combined arms” dynamic and unusual mechanics of the Caligni forces to offer a new and unique challenge for heroes arriving in the Darklands. Their unusual fighting style should push Pathfinders to try new strategies and master the Caligni’s strengths and weaknesses. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]We’ll value your insights and feedback for getting the design of the Caligni right, so I look forward to reading all your thoughts and suggestions. [/p][h2] 
Art Vision and Pipeline [/h2][p align="justify"]Now let’s look at how designs like these are re-created visually in-game. Art Director, Jonathan Dufresne described the process: [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Getting the visual design right always starts by looking at the source material. We take great inspiration from the books themselves and other art pieces from Paizo.  [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]At our current stage of production, our pipeline is well defined. It starts with reference gathering then moves to a front-and-back-view sketch. We try to keep all the key elements of the original design but adapt them to our vision.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/3d5244f87ef58c1a67561426652f396c6237df9d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Normally only one or two sketches are needed since the artwork provided by Paizo already provides so much to work with.  [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Then it’s review time. We check the proportions and ensure they’re exaggerated enough to read well from a top-down perspective. Each enemy and character must feel unique in their silhouette so we can recognize them quickly. We also minimise the number of small details in the design so the visual stays easy to read. Consulting the game design team to check the enemy visually matches in-game behaviour is also crucial. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]When we’re ready, we move to the 3D blocking. At this stage the main goal is to validate the proportions directly in-game with proper camera angles. We make sure it reads well in the context of our game first before moving to polish. At this stage we can even start animation using the 3D blocking, before we even get the final models. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]The last step is the detailed, textured enemy. At this point, we don’t really have any big surprises — there might be some small feedback regarding materials, but most of it has already been approved in previous steps.[/p][p align="justify"][/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/633700e9579b8b7ae7e2eaaf8369b86268b0777a.png"][/img] [/p][p][/p][h2]Caligni Skulker Design[/h2][p]
Now we can use the Caligni Skulker as an example of our pipeline, going from concept all the way to final. You can also see the references used on the concept art. We tried to match the original intent quite closely, mostly playing with proportions to better match our other enemies and overall art direction. [/p][p] [/p][p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/96f5e506a6ebebb7dfe8588ea79e0a12cf7e6345.png"][/img] [/p][p align="justify"]We obviously kept the tattered dark cloth and all the bandage wrapping since it’s core to the Caligni’s image, making them unique. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]Weapons are often deliberately oversized as well. Even though the original design has a dagger, we made the 3D model much bigger so it’s easy to see in-game. From a top-down perspective, it reads much smaller, making this change necessary for gameplay. [/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]As for animation and VFX, we tried to make him look quick and nimble with effects that support gameplay, like the smoke grenade. It’s at this stage that all the pieces come together and bring the character to life. [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h2]Wrapping Up [/h2][p align="justify"]Thanks for taking the time to check out our break down of the Caligni! For more sneak-peaks throughout development, follow us on social media and join the official Discord server. [/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][url="https://discord.com/invite/buNfJDc5DS"]Discord[/url] | [url="https://x.com/Pathfinder_AV"]Twitter[/url] | [url="https://www.twitch.tv/bkomstudios"]Twitch [/url]| [url="https://www.facebook.com/abominationvaultsgame/"]Facebook[/url] | [url="https://bit.ly/3Gq5qmh"]Sign up to our newsletter[/url] | [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666580/Pathfinder_Abomination_Vaults/"]Wishlist[/url][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]~ The Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults Team[/b] [/p]

notes.title: Summer Game Fest, Fogfen Concept Art, and Creature Sketches!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Adventurers! [/p][p] [/p][p]Last month, we had the pleasure of showcasing our game at Summer Game Fest. This annual video game showcase hosted by Geoff Keighley, features new game announcements, trailers, and updates from major and indie developers.[/p][p][/p][p]Lots of gaming journalists and creators came to see what [i]Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults[/i] is all about, and today, we’d love to share with you how it went! [/p][p] [/p][previewyoutube="YrqEYEn-lYc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]In case you missed it, we also took this opportunity to drop a brand-new gameplay trailer.[/i] [/p][p] [/p][h3]The MIX Summer Showcase [/h3][p]We first swung by [u][url="https://mediaindieexchange.com/showcases/summer-showcase-2025"]The Mix Summer Showcase[/url][/u] in downtown Los Angeles and demo’d [i]Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults[/i]. This is another annual showcase specifically for[b] [/b]indie games, organized by Media Indie Exchange (MIX) and running alongside Summer Game Fest. [/p][p][/p][p]The opportunity to share the space with so many other talented developers and spend the evening talking and playing games was incredibly fun. If you missed the event, you can tune in to watch the [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=03q7TknJMeI"]online showcase[/url][/u]. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jjbR3eER-9s;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Our own Creative Director, Wyatt Gray, gave this interview to Seasoned Gaming at the Mix![/i] [/p][p][/p][h3]The Build[/h3][p]Our intention was to throw players straight into the action, so the version of the game we displayed threw players deep into the Vaults, directly starting at Level 8.  At this depth, the map is mesmerising but deadly. This Darklands cavern is filled with dangerous enemies and hazards such as poisonous spores. [/p][p]It took the squad through tutorials on combat, group-obstacle clearing and much more. Eventually, players made their way through to the chamber of the boss: the monstrous Urthagul. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/7a3a32363312671197450e3bfbf9fa25ac66ff13.png"][/img][/p][h3]Summer Game Fest [/h3][p]At the Summer Game Fest Play Days event, we used this same build to showcase [i]Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults[/i] to gaming press and creators who had arranged to visit. Over the following three days, the game was shared in back-to-back appointments, and we’re delighted to say was massively enjoyed! [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/71dba3a8df55f97f5552a685a1dfa0b54c48a569.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here are some of the articles written in the days following Summer Game Fest: [/p][p][/p][p][u][url="https://mobilesyrup.com/2025/06/13/summer-game-fest-2025-canadian-games/"]Mobile Syrup – Canadians were behind some of Summer Game Fest’s most creative games[/url][/u] [/p][p][i]“You’ll be encouraged to create combos with your different characters, like special flame vortexes or poisoning scimitar slashes.”[/i] [/p][p] [/p][p][u][url="https://techraptor.net/gaming/previews/pathfinder-abomination-vaults-preview-focused-on-teamwork"]TechRaptor – Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults Preview – Focused on Teamwork[/url][/u] [/p][p][i]“Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults looks like it will be a good time, particularly with friends. It has a let’s grab some food and drinks, chill for a bit, and just go on an adventure vibe.”[/i] [/p][p] [/p][p][u][url="https://games.mxdwn.com/news/summer-games-fest-2025-megabit-games-galore-previews-of-omut-thick-as-thieves-and-pathfinder-abomination-vaults/"]mxdwn – Previews of Omut, Thick as Thieves, and Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults[/url][/u] [/p][p][i]“If you’re into ARPGs that focus more on fun with your friends this game will be for you.”[/i] [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/bf1b47284597aae6eb2a5a7195cb1c4b279984a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The event held a fantastic atmosphere, and everyone was excited to get hands-on with the game. Our setup was a sofa in front of a large screen and captured the couch Co-Op feeling perfectly. [/p][p][/p][p]Creative Director Wyatt summed up the experience:[i] [/i] [/p][p]
"[i]At SGF, I had the opportunity to sit with prominent influencers and members of the press to battle alongside them, through hordes of spiders and other unwelcoming subterranean locals -- while telling them a bit about our vision for the game.[/i] 
  
[i]Putting our game in the hands of the press for the first time -- and getting to hear their feedback, thoughts, and reactions -- was incredibly energizing. During development, our heads are so buried in the weeds that it's easy to forget how far we have already come, and to regain perspective on what's working well and what we need to focus on more.[/i] [/p][p] [/p][p][i]One thing I was pleased to see was how anyone, including folks who were novices on a gamepad, could pick up the controller and have a blast within just one minute of learning the controls. One of our tenets is the classic "easy to learn, hard to master" and I'd say we are progressing nicely on that front.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][i]Surprisingly, one of my favorite moments was after we failed a boss fight. I was a bit worried, asking the two journalists I was playing with if they were willing to give it another shot. But then I saw it... that glint of determination (or maybe vengeance?) in their eyes, as they insisted we give it one more go, because they knew exactly how they would do things differently the second time around. And that second time around, we worked together much better and absolutely crushed the boss! The players were thrilled with their well-earned victory and couldn't wait for the next challenge. I guess you could say that "losing is fun!"[/i] [/p][p] [/p][p][i]Another of my favorite moments was at the end of my second day. The journalist and I had just finished playing through the entire demo (while I yapped for 15 minutes) and defeated the boss soundly. I answered a few of his questions and we were about ready to wrap up when he paused for a moment and asked, "Hey... could we play it again?" I was thrilled! So, we played the entire demo again, this time swapping between characters and trying out all the abilities.[/i] [/p][p] [/p][p][i]I can't wait for all our new friends from SGF to see the progress we'll have made when we return next year![/i]"[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/afb7a95797a432d2a3f7e1103f98b17b5dea88ed.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Members of the development and publishing team on site[/i] [/p][p] [/p][h2]Bonus Reveal: Swamps of Fogfen Concept Art Spotlight[/h2][p][/p][p]Moving on to how development on the game is going! Here are some sneak peeks. [/p][p][/p][p]The swamp concept art you see here represents an early exploration of the [b]Fogfen[/b], the moody, mist-drenched wetland that borders Otari. Designed to feel both magical and menacing, these environments play with verticality, dense foliage and a thick layer of creeping fog that twists perception. Trees stretch like skeletal fingers through the mist, while hidden ruins and half-sunken pathways tease dangers just out of view. These pieces help guide our lighting, color scripting, and mood composition for future surface-world content. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/d416980ed36c1ac9107c4425fe74b2555eefcf3a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/1cb2f0ef769fbf7cc56e1c8edc5350fd9f39f298.png"][/img][/p][h2]Exciting times at BKOM Studios! [/h2][p][/p][p]We had the pleasure of welcoming our amazing partners from Megabit Publishing to our Quebec City studio for a series of dynamic workshops with the development team. It was a week of expanding our creative horizons, sparking bold ideas and reinforcing our shared vision for the game. [/p][p]From meaningful conversations to inspiring collaboration, the road ahead promises exciting challenges and unforgettable gameplay experiences. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/32f309a8eaa890dee044a1101c45edafc20e994d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Creature Sketches from the Vault [/h2][p][/p][p]And because we know you love creatures as much as we do, here’s a peek at some of our monster concept sketches revealed during development: [/p][list][*][p]The Seugathi Servant, a grotesque mind-warped worm with psychic eyes and bladed tails. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A Ghost, ethereal and sorrowful, floating in tattered robes with supernatural grace. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/6a6b23a1fedc659325305b6d461a835c8e0c2dc3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/32064340551a2b2631f16df9d9921813d548287b.png"][/img][/p][p]These early illustrations not only inform our modelling and animation pipelines but also help capture the tone and lore of Pathfinder’s universe. Expect these designs to evolve as we finalize VFX passes, voice work, and monster behavior. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/aace8b732e28c08dac0fd0e5b3ebfea5a2b3dd04.gif"][/img][/p][p]On top of that, the team has been actively iterating on the Squadplay HUD, implementing animations and working on object interaction User Experience as well as quick time events prompt mockups. We’re also making a big push on squadplay mechanics, adding new features like giving precise orders to the teammates, or performing combos to break specific enemy defenses! [/p][p] [/p][p]We can’t wait to give you more information on the above and show you what that looks like in a future update. Stay tuned! [/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime: keep your spells ready, your shield steady, and your stamina optimal. You’re going to need them! [/p][p][/p][p]Onward to adventure! [/p][p][/p][p][i][b]The Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults Team[/b][/i] [/p][p][/p][p]Follow us: [/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/buNfJDc5DS"]Discord[/url] | [url="https://x.com/Pathfinder_AV"]Twitter[/url] | [url="https://www.twitch.tv/bkomstudios"]Twitch [/url]| [url="https://www.facebook.com/abominationvaultsgame/"]Facebook[/url] | [url="https://bit.ly/3Gq5qmh"]Sign up to our newsletter[/url] | [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666580/Pathfinder_Abomination_Vaults/"]Wishlist[/url][/p]

Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults is indeed Dungeons & Dragons based, after the Abomination Vaults Adventure Path. Well, it’s actually based on something that’s based on D&D—it’s D&D inception, really. But I guess every RPG has some Dungeons & Dragons inspiration deep down, so here we are. Alright, that is it for the D&D talk. notes.title: Vault Dwellers: Creatures of the Dark!
notes.content:
Greetings, adventurers!

Last time, we introduced you to the slimy menace known as the [b]Slurk[/b], a mucus-coated brute with tusks and a temperament as slippery as its trail. But the horrors of Gauntlight Keep run far deeper than amphibious ogres. Today, we’re giving a quick look at what we’re preparing for this summer, including awesome events we’ll be attending, and we’re diving into the thick of it with an unsettling look at several of the monstrosities lurking below. [b]Prepare yourselves![/b]

This is [i]Abomination Vaults, after all.[/i]

[h2]Ghoul[/h2]

Not all who descend into the darkness die. Some hunger! [b]Ghouls[/b] are undead cursed by ravenous, unending appetites for the flesh of the living. Born from necromantic corruption or cursed affliction, these creatures retain twisted remnants of their former selves, driven by primal need and a sinister cunning. But in the depths of Gauntlight, ghouls are more than scavengers, some are devotees.

Among them dwell [i]ghoul cultists[/i], once-living fanatics who willingly submitted to undeath in service of [b]Belcorra’s dark ambitions[/b]. Adventurers uncover a macabre underworld beneath the keep where these cultists preserve ancient rites, perform grotesque rituals and jealously guard the secrets of undeath. Their lairs reek of rot, their [b]minds are twisted[/b] and their [b]claws strike fear[/b] into even the most hardened heroes.

notes.title: 🧵 Potions, Pirates, and Peril – New Faces and New Mysteries in Otari! ⚗️
notes.content:
Hail, adventurers! 

Another exciting moment has passed, and we're thrilled to share everything that's been happening in the world of [i]Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults[/i]! Strap in for a roundup of your feedback, gameplay highlights, and some surprises coming your way!

[h2]Amelia Candlebright: The Seamstress with a Pirate’s Past[/h2]
New in Otari, but no stranger to adventure, Amelia Candlebright is here to stitch together more than just fine outfits! Once a daring pirate, she’s traded the high seas for high fashion, using plundered fabrics and battle-hardened needlework to craft armor worthy of any adventurer. Her shop, Talia’s Tailoring Emporium, is a treasure trove of expertly stitched gear, rune-imbued embroidery, and a few secrets hidden in its seams. But who is Talia? A lost companion? A pseudonym she can’t quite remember to use?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/513e62ed21f07176e2d26bb9e2f4ce7784d51ef8.png[/img]

They say Amelia sees things others miss—rivalries, alliances, and truths buried under layers of deception. She won’t tell you what to do, but if you listen closely, her wisdom may just be the key to your next great discovery. And if you’re up for a bit of treasure hunting, well… let’s just say old habits die hard.

[h3]More About Amelia Candlebright[/h3]
[b]A Life Sewn from Adventure[/b] – Once the captain of *The Thimble*, a ship as unassuming as its name but deceptively swift, Amelia ruled the seas with a sharp mind and an even sharper wit. Whether she was smuggling contraband or plundering cargo, she always made sure her ship and crew were in pristine condition—something that naturally translated into her masterful tailoring.

[b]A Stitch in Time… and Magic[/b] – Amelia’s creations aren’t just stylish—they’re woven with magic. Using an ancient art of runecrafting through embroidery, she stitches protective wards and hidden messages into the fabric of every piece she makes. To the untrained eye, it’s just fine threadwork. To the adventurer in the know, it could be the difference between life and death.

[b]A Keen Eye for More Than Fashion[/b] – Though she keeps her thoughts to herself, Amelia sees through people. Years at sea have taught her to read a crew, and that skill carries over to the tangled relationships in Otari. If she ever chooses to share an observation, you'd best listen—because she’s already figured out how the threads of fate are weaving together.

[b]Treasure Hunting Never Ends[/b] – Even in retirement, Amelia's love for the thrill of the hunt hasn’t faded. Her personal quests often involve hidden caches, sunken ships, and legendary artifacts, and she might just need the help of a few capable adventurers to retrieve them. You didn’t think she settled down for good, did you?

Ready to don a cloak stitched with secrets? Need a coat strong enough to withstand a cutlass and a fireball? Or are you simply drawn to the stories Amelia Candlebright refuses to tell? Find out when you visit Talia’s Tailoring Emporium!

[h2]Meet Glimm Fizzletop – The Mad Genius of The Alchematorium![/h2]
Adventurers, hold onto your flasks—because Glimm Fizzletop has rolled into town! This wise-cracking, potion-slinging gnome has set up his legendary wagon, The Alchematorium, in Otari, and he’s ready to mix, brew, and maybe slightly explode his way into history!

Glimm’s passion for alchemy is unmatched, and his thirst for discovery pushes him to the very limits of what’s “safe” (and sometimes well beyond). Need potions? He’s got ‘em. Want something experimental? He’ll even let you mix your own—but don’t! His quests will send you on thrilling ingredient hunts, from the depths of Gauntlight Keep to the most forbidden corners of the wilds. While being new to Otari—but no stranger to its history—he’s especially interested in anything new, powerful, or strange…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/7053f08b648312dd0900e538c173e33224a90f4e.png[/img]

But behind the bubbling cauldrons and witty remarks, Glimm carries a secret—one that has driven him from his past life in Absalom and fuels his obsession with the ultimate potion. Will your adventurers uncover the truth? Will Glimm finally discover the perfect combination of ingredients that he seeks?

Potion-crafting, rare ingredients, and alchemical chaos await! Who’s ready to help Glimm push the limits of magic and science? Let us know in the thread!

[h3]More About Glimm Fizzletop[/h3]
[b]A Mind That Never Rests[/b] – Glimm doesn’t just make potions—he invents them. He’s spent his entire life testing the limits of alchemy, always convinced that the next discovery will be his greatest. If you ask him about a potion, be prepared for an enthusiastic (and probably way too detailed) lecture on how it was made, how it could be improved, and why it’s just what you’re looking for in your time of need. Trust him!

[b]A Collector… of Everything[/b] – Glimm can’t resist a rare ingredient, no matter how dangerous, volatile, or possibly cursed it might be. If it’s new, he needs it. His wagon is a chaotic mess of half-labeled vials, bubbling experiments, and dusty old tomes filled with cryptic notes in the margins. He insists there’s a system to it… but not everyone in Otari agrees… especially Magiloy, who has been known to mix a brew or two in her time.

[b]Haunted by the Past[/b] – Though he’s built a reputation as a skilled alchemist, whispers from Absalom suggest otherwise. Some say he fled after a terrible accident, one that left a permanent mark on his soul. As adventurers help him track down exotic ingredients, they may start to unravel the truth: his ultimate potion isn’t just a scientific pursuit—it’s an act of redemption.

[h3]Help Glimm, Uncover His Secrets, and Brew Some Chaos![/h3]
Want a potion that makes you run faster than a horse? How about one that lets you breathe fire… but also maybe hiccup explosions? If you’re up for experimental alchemy, The Alchematorium is open for business—just don’t ask about the burn marks on the walls.

What kind of alchemical disaster do you see Glimm getting into? 

[h2]The Adventure Begins: The Dangerous Road to Otari[/h2]
Now, let’s pull back the curtain on the first environment in the adventure—the dangerous road that winds its way to Otari, leading the adventurers to the legendary Gauntlight Keep.

Our design team has crafted a landscape that blends ancient ruins with eerie natural beauty, where every cobblestone and weathered monument whispers tales of lost eras.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/b0bc256df361cb97eae9bcebae5389e87c69908f.gif[/img]

Expect a medley of environmental puzzles, hidden lore, and encounters with mysterious denizens that challenge your resolve.

The road to Otari sets the stage for the ominous grandeur of Gauntlight Keep, with its winding paths, unexpected ambushes, and breathtaking vistas that will captivate your imagination and keep you on the edge of your seat.

[h2]Behind the Art: The Magic of Conceptual Creation[/h2]
Ever wondered how we create these concept arts we showed in the past?

Our artists employ a process that transforms raw game captures into works of art. Starting with close-up shots of the game’s most evocative moments, they embark on a journey of creative reinterpretation through detailed paintovers.

By merging in-game imagery with their own creative insights, our artists create a visual narrative that not only honors the original design but also expands it into something unexpectedly beautiful and deeply resonant.

This concept art, below, shows the perspective of our artist from an area from the road to Gauntlight Keep where a broken bridge is to be seen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/f4e31c616f1ed21d50816b3e6f39fdbafd4a22b3.gif[/img]

[h2]From the Road to Gauntlight Keep to its Ruins[/h2]
To end this update, we’re more than happy to show you the new concept arts of the Gauntlight Ruins surroundings and what inspired our artists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/275d374ab481e511586f7e011aab24da07178b4b.png[/img]

[h2]What kind of creatures lurk in these areas?[/h2]
Skulking in the shadows of ruined halls and forgotten tunnels, Mitflits are a wretched and pitiful breed of gremlins, forever cursed with feelings of inadequacy and despair. Small, blue-skinned, and perpetually hunched, they compensate for their weakness with sheer numbers and an almost comical sense of self-importance.

Though they crave recognition and leadership, their cowardly nature often leads them to grovel before stronger creatures—be it a cruel master or a self-proclaimed "mighty" mitflit chief.

Despite their failings, mitflits are dangerous in swarms, wielding crude weapons and enlisting oversized vermin like spiders and centipedes to do their bidding.

In the depths of Abomination Vaults, they scuttle through the dark, whispering their schemes, eager to prove themselves… even if they fail spectacularly in the process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/7266059cff79a11aa17dab31122d362bc1c01a9d.gif[/img]

[h2]❓ Q&A Video #4: Your Questions Answered[/h2]

Our developers sat down to answer even more of your burning questions about the game, mechanics, and future plans. Missed it? Watch the Q&A #4 video right here:

📼 [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/iYD4x-ohFQg]Have any questions? We might have answered them here![/url]

Thanks for being an incredible community. Until next time, happy adventuring! 🗡️✨

The Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults Team

notes.title: The Road to Gauntlight Keep
notes.content:
Greetings Heroes,

Our team has been working hard, and we’re ready to reveal a lot of new developments about the Abomination Vaults. Read on for an in-depth look at the fresh characters, mysterious paths, and artistic magic that are transforming our world!

[h2]Captain Lardus Longsaddle: The Unyielding Vanguard[/h2]

[i]"Steel, honor, and a touch of pragmatism—Captain Lardus Longsaddle stands as Otari's stalwart protector."[/i]

Our latest concept art reveal brings you face-to-face with Captain Lardus Longsaddle, the grizzled and unwavering captain of Otari’s guard. Whether you see him as a dedicated shield for the people or a hardened enforcer of law and order, Lardus is a name known by every citizen and adventurer alike.

[h2]Who is Captain Lardus?[/h2]

Lardus Longsaddle is a seasoned warrior who was a veteran of Absalom's city guards who "retired" to Otari a decade ago. He’s not just the captain of the guard—he is the law. He may be a grump, while not as rigid as some would expect, Lardus has a no-nonsense attitude when it comes to dealing with threats, whether they emerge from the town’s underbelly or creep from the dark maw of Gauntlight Keep.

While he trusts in steel and strategy, Lardus is no fool—he knows Otari’s safety can’t always rest in the hands of his guards alone. He keeps a watchful eye on the adventurers stirring trouble (or solving it), though his patience for reckless heroics has its limits.

notes.title: A New Era with Megabit Publishing!

Greetings Heroes,

As we step into 2025, we’re excited to share an announcement that marks the beginning of an incredible new chapter for [i]Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults[/i].

Thanks to you, we already achieved remarkable milestones, including [b]over 5,000 backers[/b] during our successful [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b]. Your support has been the foundation of this project.

notes.title: It's time to kick off 2025 on Steam!
notes.content:
Good day, dear Pathfinder fans!

Let's kick off 2025 with a glimpse into new levels from the Abomination Vaults!

[h2]The Servants’ Quarters in Gauntlight Keep[/h2]

The [b]Servants’ Quarters[/b] in Gauntlight Keep offer a haunting insight into the lives of those who once toiled under Belcorra Haruvex’s rule. These decrepit halls are rich with environmental storytelling, where adventurers will uncover remnants of past lives, eerie echoes of former inhabitants, and lurking dangers that now call this space home. As the battleground of warring factions—the subterranean Morlocks, the scavenging Mitflits, and the ever-hungry Ghouls—this area pulses with intrigue and conflict, offering players a chance to shape its fate. Will you side with a faction, manipulate their rivalries, or carve your own path through this treacherous domain?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/98dbec5fce4e80341213550f1fcfe3e1524666b8.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Laboratory Floor in Gauntlight Keep[/h2]

Deep within the Abomination Vaults lies the [b]Laboratory Floor[/b]—a domain of dark experimentation and arcane horrors. Here, the Seugathis continue their grotesque fleshwarping research, resisting the encroaching devils that threaten their stronghold. The remnants of ancient gladiatorial games linger in abandoned beast pens and bloodstained armories, hinting at the brutal past of Gauntlight Keep. Players will face seugathi fleshwarpers, twisted aberrations, and infernal invaders while uncovering forbidden knowledge and treasures of immense power. Will you dismantle the Seugathis’ twisted experiments, negotiate with their leaders, or become entangled in the infernal conflict threatening to consume this floor?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/db0b16c80198670fe006412e67256cd554dce236.png[/img]

[h2]A Glimpse Into the Cosmos: Wrin Sivinxi[/h2]

You want more? You got it! We hope you enjoy when we bring you extra content—be it concept art, in-game screenshots, or more. 

Adventurers, behold the captivating new concept art of [b]Wrin Sivinxi[/b], the enigmatic proprietor of [b]Wrin's Wonders[/b]! This otherworldly shop, brimming with strange curios, esoteric artifacts, and astrological trinkets, is a haven for those seeking to uncover secrets beyond mortal understanding.

Wrin is no ordinary merchant. Her cosmic insight and deep connection to the stars make her a guide like no other. Many whisper that her knowledge stems from visions gifted by alien intelligences or the vastness of the Astral Plane itself. She specializes in aiding adventurers destined to face unimaginable horrors, offering cryptic advice and one-of-a-kind items that may turn the tide of fate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/9b089d79a6d8fbb88d9f9b246d223170e3e2cf9a.png[/img]

[h2]Concept Art Showcase: Captain Lardus Longsaddle[/h2]

Introducing [b]Captain Lardus Longsaddle[/b], the unyielding protector of Otari! Whether you see him as a noble shield against chaos or a strict enforcer of order, Captain Lardus is a name that carries weight in the city. Our latest concept art brings this iconic figure to life, showcasing his rugged armor and battle-hardened resolve. How will your adventurers see him? As a trusted ally, a bureaucratic obstacle, or something else entirely? Let us know your thoughts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/db2c0d156a5032772781e31244444fe0302cd255.png[/img]

Please remember that these are [b]concept artworks[/b], created solely for [b]artistic intent[/b]. They [b]do not represent[/b] the [b]final product[/b].

Are you ready to delve deeper into the darkness of Gauntlight Keep? Stay tuned for more reveals and surprises in the weeks ahead!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787730/048afbe1a76f07ce9fd2628046d1a834ba5a9311.jpg[/img]

His animations now flow more naturally as well, thanks to improved motion capture and finer animations. 

We believe these changes will deepen immersion in the game, making each character’s personality more [b]vivid [/b]and [b]engaging[/b].

Of course, Harsk is not the only one having massive overhauls as [b]Amiri[/b], [b]Ezren [/b]and [b]Kyra [/b]will be shown in a near future.
